sentences.text: Apollo 11 was the spaceflight that landed the first two humans on the Moon .	spaceflight	spaceflight	landed	Moon landing	Moon	Moon

Mission commander Neil Armstrong and pilot Buzz Aldrin , both American , landed the lunar module Eagle on July 20 , 1969 , at 20:18 UTC .	Neil Armstrong	Neil Armstrong	Armstrong	Neil Armstrong	Aldrin	Buzz Aldrin	landed	Moon landing	Buzz Aldrin	Buzz Aldrin	lunar module	Apollo Lunar Module	UTC	Coordinated Universal Time

Armstrong became the first to step onto the lunar surface six hours later on July 21 at 02:56:15 UTC ; Aldrin joined him about 20 minutes later .	Armstrong	Neil Armstrong	Aldrin	Buzz Aldrin	UTC	Coordinated Universal Time
They spent about two and a quarter hours together outside the spacecraft , and collected 47.5 lb of lunar material to bring back to Earth .	spacecraft	Apollo (spacecraft)

Michael Collins piloted the command module Columbia alone in lunar orbit while they were on the Moon 's surface .	Michael Collins	Michael Collins (astronaut)	Collins	Michael Collins (astronaut)	Moon	Moon	command module	Apollo Command/Service Module
Armstrong and Aldrin spent just under a day on the lunar surface before rendezvousing with Columbia in lunar orbit .	Armstrong	Neil Armstrong	Aldrin	Buzz Aldrin

Apollo 11 was launched by a Saturn V rocket from Kennedy Space Center in Merritt Island , Florida , on July 16 , and was the fifth manned mission of NASA 's Apollo program . The Apollo spacecraft had three parts : a command module -LRB- CM -RRB- with a cabin for the three astronauts , and the only part that landed back on Earth ; a service module -LRB- SM -RRB- , which supported the command module with propulsion , electrical power , oxygen , and water ; and a lunar module -LRB- LM -RRB- that had two stages -- a lower stage for landing on the Moon , and an upper stage to place the astronauts back into lunar orbit .	landed	Moon landing	Moon	Moon	lunar module	Apollo Lunar Module	command module	Apollo Command/Service Module	spacecraft	Apollo (spacecraft)

After being sent toward the Moon by the Saturn V 's upper stage , the astronauts separated the spacecraft from it and traveled for three days until they entered into lunar orbit .	Saturn V	Saturn V	Moon	Moon	spacecraft	Apollo (spacecraft)

Armstrong and Aldrin then moved into the lunar module Eagle and landed in the Sea of Tranquility .	Armstrong	Neil Armstrong	Aldrin	Buzz Aldrin	landed	Moon landing	lunar module	Apollo Lunar Module	Sea of Tranquility	Mare Tranquillitatis
They stayed a total of about 21.5 hours on the lunar surface .

The astronauts used Eagle '' 's upper stage to lift off from the lunar surface and rejoin Collins in the command module .	Collins	Michael Collins (astronaut)	command module	Apollo Command/Service Module
They jettisoned Eagle '' before they performed the maneuvers that blasted them out of lunar orbit on a trajectory back to Earth .
They returned to Earth and landed in the Pacific Ocean on July 24 .	landed	Moon landing

Kennedy : `` before this decade is out , of landing a man on the Moon and returning him safely to the Earth .
